en: Black‑and‑white view of a large Neoclassical town-hall-like building with a central portico of four columns and an ornate balcony above, surmounted by a tall square clock tower with two large clock faces and a flagpole. The building opens onto a broad cobblestoned square where people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European clothing stroll and socialize. To the left is an adjoining building with arched shopfronts; a large awning reads "CAFE WIEN." The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city square.
